name: Free Drop-In Health Clinic
description: A free weekly medical clinic at the Amherst Survival Center. All are welcome (ages 2+); no insurance or appointment needed. Offers school and camp physicals for children. Open Mondays 12pm-2pm.
contact: Amherst Survival Center, 138 Sunderland Rd., North Amherst, MA 01059; 413-549-3968
